page_title: AST 2-2 CRY | Aston Villa v Crystal Palace 23/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+4' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) goes for goal with a shot from long range, but the effort flies painfully wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
90+2' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) will replace Ismaila Sarr.
90' Oliver Glasner prepares a substitution. Will Hughes is replaced by Chris Richards (Crystal Palace).
90' Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) plays a through ball but overhits it. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Aston Villa.
87' It's a yellow card for Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace).
85' Tim Robinson shows a yellow card to Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) for his blatant foul.
83' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
82' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa) replacing Leon Bailey.
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Morgan Rogers will be replaced by Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa).

82' A terrific piece of skill by Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) inside the box gives him a clear goal scoring opportunity, but his shot is blocked right on the line by a defender after the keeper was beaten. The ball goes out for a corner. Aston Villa can continue in their attacking effort.
80' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was! The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.

80' What a great touch by Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
80' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is penalised for holding. Tim Robinson signals a set piece.

77' 2 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header into the top right corner. 2:2.
77' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) will take the corner.
77' Trevoh Chalobah (Crystal Palace) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
76' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Aston Villa force their opponents to concede a corner.

76' The corner is swung in and Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker over the bar from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
75' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
75' Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick. Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
74' Oliver Glasner has decided to substitute Justin Devenny and he is replaced by Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace).
73' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
72' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) sends a lofted pass into the penalty area from a free kick, but the opposition's defence manages to control all the attacking players and thwart the threat.
70' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
69' Unai Emery has decided to make a change. Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) replaces John McGinn.
69' Ian Maatsen goes off the pitch and Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) comes on.
68' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) takes the corner with a short pass.
68' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall. Crystal Palace get a corner.
66' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
66' A clumsy foul by Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) and Tim Robinson blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Crystal Palace.
64' Substitution. Cheick Doucoure leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace).
62' Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
59' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) was quite harsh and Tim Robinson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
57' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It's a throw-in for Aston Villa.
55' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
55' Aston Villa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
52' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
51' Wonderful movement. Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) connects with a cross inside the box and plants a header goalwards, but Emiliano Martinez makes a superb save.
50' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
50' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Aston Villa have a corner.
49' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
49' He should have scored! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
48' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
46' Unai Emery has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Matty Cash (Aston Villa) comes on the pitch for Lamare Bogarde.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' The resulting corner from Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) is cleared.

45+4' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Aston Villa.
45+1' 1 - 2 Goal - 1:2! Ismaila Sarr laid the ball off to Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
45' Aston Villa work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the right side of the goal, but it's not enough to beat Dean Henderson who easily stops the effort.
45' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
44' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Aston Villa!
43' There's a break in play and referee Tim Robinson must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Aston Villa using VAR. This could be interesting!
42' Poor challenge! Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) is penalised for tripping and Tim Robinson blows his whistle. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Aston Villa.
42' Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

39' OFF THE POST! Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the right post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
39' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
36' 1 - 1 Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) goes on mazy run which culminates with a one-on-one with the keeper. He keeps his cool and calmly dispatches the ball into the net.

35' John McGinn (Aston Villa) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Morgan Rogers was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
33' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.

33' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Aston Villa are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
31' Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

28' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom left corner, but Dean Henderson made an astonishing save!
28' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
26' Tim Robinson blows his whistle and it's Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
24' The resulting corner, taken by Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa), comes to nothing.
24' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. Good work from Aston Villa as they win a corner.
23' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) takes a short free kick.
23' Tim Robinson interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace). Aston Villa win a free kick.
21' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
19' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
18' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.

17' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Emiliano Martinez pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
17' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Ollie Watkins, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
16' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
15' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Tim Robinson stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.

13' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
12' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

12' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The referee blows his whistle, Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
11' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but Emiliano Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.

10' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
9' Tim Robinson couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Trevoh Chalobah (Crystal Palace) and blew his whistle.
6' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.

6' Aston Villa slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

4' 0 - 1 Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Emiliano Martinez is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 0:1.
3' The ball is cleared after Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Crystal Palace will take a throw-in.
2' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Pau Torres (Aston Villa) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Crystal Palace will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Tim Robinson.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
